_about: Announcements from the hosts. Only entries with "published": true are shown. Entries marked "specimen": true are design samples and are shown only while site.json has "showSpecimens": true.

notices.title: How a notice will look
notices.body: This is a specimen, not a real announcement. Notices from the hosts will be pinned here as they are posted: reminders, booklet releases and anything that changes.
